headline: Dynamic Archistructures Ltd is a BSE-only, group-X NBFC whose last trade on the exchange was 12 March 2025 - 18 months before collection. Every live-looking number on every site (price, market cap, P/E, P/B, 52w range) is derived from that single stale tick, and no source labels it as stale except by a small 'as on' date.

legal_name.note: Company's own Reg-31 filing header: 'Name of the company: DYNAMIC ARCHISTRUCTURES LIMITED'. BSE ListofScripData renders Issuer_Name as 'dynamic Archistructures Limited' (lower-case d) and Scrip_Name as 'Dynamic Archistructures Ltd' - three spellings across two authoritative records.

former_names.note: No rename found. 30th AGM in 2026 and incorporation in 1996 are consistent with an unbroken identity; no name-change announcement appears in the 2026 BSE announcement feed.
former_names.confidence: medium - absence of evidence, not evidence of absence

nse_symbol.note: Company's own filing states 'NSE Symbol: NOTLISTED' and 'MSEI Symbol: NOTLISTED'. BSE-only is confirmed by the issuer, not merely inferred from a master file.

bse_scrip_id.note: BSE's scrip_id / SecurityId is literally 'DAL'. This is the string that collides with NYSE:DAL.

board.note: NOT SME. The Reg-31 filing answers 'Whether company is SME: No'. Group X is BSE's illiquid/non-margin segment, not an SME board. Settlement type T+1 per BSE ComHeader.

sector.note: BSE: Sector='Financial Services', IGroup='Finance', ISubGroup='Non Banking Financial Company (NBFC)'. CONTRADICTED by Moneycontrol - see source_conflicts.C1.

business_description.value: Non-Systemically Important Non-Deposit Taking Non-Banking Financial Company in Kolkata, West Bengal, in the business of finance and investment in mutual funds, shares, debentures, stock, bonds and other securities.
business_description.note: Moneycontrol's own page text agrees: 'Dynamic Archistructures Ltd is a NBFC and all its activities relates to one segment ie, non banking financial activities and its operations are confined within India.' - while that same page labels the Industry 'Construction & Contracting - Civil'.

incorporated.note: screener: 'Incorporated in 1996'. Corroborated by the 30th AGM held 2026-09-21.

listing_date.note: GENUINE GAP. The Reg-31 filing's own field 'Date of allotment / extinguishment ... / Listing Date' is BLANK. No BSE endpoint reachable without auth exposes a listing date. Circumstantial only (NOT recorded as a value): scrip code 539681 is in the 2015-16 allotment range and the company's own site publishes shareholding patterns starting Mar-2016 and Reg-33 quarterly results from June-2014.

last_close.note: CRITICAL: this is NOT a current price. BSE returns Ason='12 Mar 25 | 16:00'. Open=High=Low=LTP=49.88 and total traded quantity was 12,000 shares - a single print. As of collection this quote is 556 days old.

last_trade_date.note: Independently confirmed by Moneycontrol ('As on 12 Mar, 2025 | 04:00') and screener.in (price stamped '12 Mar 2025').

traded_quantity_last_session.note: BSE StockTrading: TTQ '0.12' with TTQin '(Lakh)' = 12,000 shares; Turnover '5.99' Lakh = INR 5,98,560 = 12,000 x 49.88. NOTE the unit trap: BSE reports turnover/quantity in LAKH while reporting market cap in CRORE on the same response.

market_cap.note: BSE MktCapFull=24.99. Free-float market cap MktCapFF=7.28 INR crore (29.14% public). screener.in rounds to 25.0 INR crore. Both are 49.88 x 50,10,000 shares, i.e. a market cap computed off an 18-month-old tick.

pe_ttm.note: Agreed by both sources: screener 'Stock P/E 24.5', BSE ComHeaderNew PE='24.50'. But the agreement is hollow - numerator is the stale 2025-03-12 price and the denominator is a TTM EPS built from quarters swinging -7.52 to +11.96. BSE's OTHER endpoint (ComHeader, non-'New') returns PE='-' for the same scrip on the same day.

pb.note: CONFLICT - see source_conflicts.C2. BSE ComHeaderNew PB='0.69'; screener.in states 'Stock is trading at 0.75 times its book value'. 49.88 / 66.7 = 0.748, so screener is internally consistent and BSE's 0.69 implies a book value of ~72.3 that BSE does not publish.

roe.note: CONFLICT - see source_conflicts.C3. screener.in headline ROE = -2.57% (FY26, loss year) and its Ratios row confirms 'ROE % Mar 2026: -2.57%'. BSE ComHeaderNew returns ROE='2.83' (positive) for the same company on the same day. screener also publishes multi-year ROE: 3-year 7.39%, 5-year 6%, 10-year 6%.

roce.note: screener.in only. BSE publishes no ROCE for this scrip (OPM and NPM both return '-').

debt_to_equity.note: screener Balance Sheet shows Borrowing = 0.00 INR crore in every one of the 12 years Mar-2015..Mar-2026, and flags 'Company is almost debt free.' Equity = 5.01 (capital) + 28.39 (reserves) = 33.40 INR crore.

revenue_ttm.basis: Sum of Sep-2025 (0.12) + Dec-2025 (2.58) + Mar-2026 (0.01) + Jun-2026 (7.26); screener's own TTM column agrees at 9.97.

net_profit_ttm.basis: Sum of -2.11 + 0.91 + -3.77 + 5.99 = 1.02; screener TTM column agrees.

revenue_growth_yoy.note: BASIS MATTERS AND THE SOURCE CONTRADICTS ITSELF. (a) Annual P&L basis: FY26 revenue 1.56 vs FY25 5.84 INR crore = -73.3%. (b) Sum-of-quarters basis for the same two years: FY26 (5.00+0.12+2.58+0.01)=7.71 vs FY25 (2.62+3.50+1.14+0.48)=7.74 = -0.4%. The two bases come from two tables on the SAME screener page and cannot both be right. FY24 is the control: quarters sum to 7.01 and the annual row is 7.01 - they reconcile, so the FY25/FY26 mismatch is a data defect, not a definitional convention. (c) screener's own 'Compounded Sales Growth TTM' cell reads -1%.

eps_ttm.note: screener TTM EPS 2.05. BSE ComHeaderNew reports EPS='2.04' and CEPS='2.08' - a 1 paisa disagreement on EPS.

book_value_per_share.note: screener 'Book Value 66.7'. Reconciles exactly with the Mar-2026 balance sheet: (equity capital 5.01 + reserves 28.39) INR crore / 50,10,000 shares = INR 66.67. BSE publishes no book value but its PB of 0.69 implies ~72.3 - see source_conflicts.C2.

shares_outstanding.note: Reg-31 filing Table I: Total 5,010,000 fully paid equity shares, 1,571 holders. Equity capital 5.01 INR crore at FV 10 confirms.

last_declared_per_share.note: NO DIVIDEND HAS EVER BEEN DECLARED in the 12 years screener carries: 'Dividend Payout %' is 0.00% for every year Mar-2015 through Mar-2026.

record_or_ex_date.note: BSE ExDate field returns '--'. The BSE announcement feed filtered to category 'Corp. Action' for 2026-01-01..2026-09-19 returns the literal string 'No Record Found!'.

low.note: BSE HighLow: Fifty2WkLow_unadj = '49.88 (12/03/2025)'. THE 52-WEEK HIGH AND LOW ARE THE SAME NUMBER ON THE SAME DAY - the entire 52-week window contains one trade, so range, volatility and %-of-range are all degenerate (range = 0). CONFLICT: Moneycontrol renders the 52-week range as 10.00 - 49.88; see source_conflicts.C4.

quarter.note: Latest FILED quarter. Taken from the company's own Regulation 31(1)(b) filing, not an aggregator.

promoter_pct.note: Reg-31 Table I: Promoter & Promoter Group, 10 shareholders, 3,550,200 of 5,010,000 shares = 70.86%. CONFLICT: screener.in publishes 70.87% for the same quarter; Moneycontrol publishes 70.86%. See source_conflicts.C5.

fii_pct.note: Reg-31 Table III category (2) 'Institutions (Foreign)' is EMPTY, and Table VI 'foreign ownership limits' shows approved 0 / utilised 0 for the current and all four prior quarters.

dii_pct.note: Reg-31 Table III category (1) 'Institutions (Domestic)' is EMPTY. The entire 29.14% public block is non-institutional.

pledged_pct_of_promoter.note: Reg-31 Declaration rows 7, 8 and 9 - pledge, non-disposal undertaking, and other encumbrances - are each answered 'No' for both Promoter and Public. Zero encumbrance is declared, not inferred.

dematerialised_shares.note: ILLIQUIDITY MECHANISM: of 5,010,000 shares only 3,687,100 are in demat form. Promoters hold all 3,550,200 of theirs in demat; the public holds just 136,900 in demat out of 1,459,800. 1,322,900 public shares - 90.6% of the free float - are still PHYSICAL and therefore untradeable on screen. That, not sentiment, is why the scrip has not printed since March 2025.

trend.note: screener's quarterly shareholding table shows promoter 70.87% / public 29.14% identical for every quarter Sep-2023 through Jun-2026, and shareholder count frozen at 1,571 since Dec-2023.

corporate_actions_2026.note: NONE. BSE's announcement API filtered to strCat='Corp. Action' over 2026-01-01..2026-09-19 returns the literal body 'No Record Found!'. Independently, none of the 25 announcements filed in 2026 is a dividend, split, bonus or rights. BSE's ExDate field is '--'. No pre-split / pre-bonus price adjustment applies to this name.

filing_date.note: 'Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of The Board Meeting For The Unaudited Financial Results For The First Quarter Ended June 30, 2026', disseminated 2026-08-12T13:44 per BSE. Board meeting intimation was filed 2026-08-06.

last_audited_annual.note: 'Audited Financial Results For The Fourth Quarter And Financial Year Ended On March 31, 2026', filed 2026-05-25.

reported_numbers_q1_fy27.note: The single largest quarter in the company's 13-quarter screener history, on a scrip that has not traded since March 2025. Q1 net profit of 5.99 INR crore against a 24.99 INR crore market cap.

last_3_announcements.headline: Notice for the 30th Annual General Meeting and Annual Report for the Financial year 2025-2026 (Reg. 34(1) Annual Report)

announcements_2026_count.note: 25 filings between 2026-01-15 and 2026-08-29. The company is a diligent filer while being untradeable - filing activity is NOT a liveness signal for price.

consolidated_vs_standalone.value: STANDALONE ONLY - no consolidated financials exist
consolidated_vs_standalone.note: BSE ComHeaderNew returns ConEPS='0.00', ConCEPS='0.00', ConPE='0.00', ConOPM='0.00', ConNPM='0.00', ConPB=null, ConROE=null. Moneycontrol's description says the company 'is a NBFC and all its activities relates to one segment ie, non banking financial activities and its operations are confined within India' - a single segment, no subsidiaries. TRAP: screener.in still SERVES /company/539681/consolidated/ with HTTP 200 and renders the full page chrome with every ratio blank, rather than 404-ing. A scraper that requests the consolidated view by default gets an empty shell, not an error.

consolidated_url_behaviour.content: page renders with Market Cap, Current Price, High/Low, Stock P/E, Book Value, Dividend Yield, ROCE, ROE and Face Value all EMPTY

a.value: Financial Services / Finance / Non Banking Financial Company (NBFC)

source_conflicts.note: Moneycontrol contradicts ITSELF on the same page: the header reads 'Industry : Construction & Contracting - Civil' while the body reads 'Dynamic Archistructures Ltd is a NBFC and all its activities relates to one segment ie, non banking financial activities'. The mis-classification is even baked into Moneycontrol's canonical URL path (/stockpricequote/constructioncontracting-civil/). Almost certainly driven by the word 'Archistructures'. BSE is authoritative; Moneycontrol is wrong.

b.source: screener.in ('trading at 0.75 times its book value')

source_conflicts.note: Same stale price 49.88 on both sides, so the disagreement is entirely in the denominator: screener's book value 66.7 (which reconciles to the Mar-2026 balance sheet exactly) vs BSE's implied ~72.3 (unpublished). Neither side labels its book-value vintage.

Sign disagreement, not a rounding gap. FY26 net profit was -0.87 INR crore on ~33.4 INR crore equity, which supports screener's negative figure; BSE's +2.83 is unexplained and undated. A terminal that picks one at random tells the user the company either lost or made money last year.

BSE is authoritative and internally consistent (one trade in the window, so high == low). Moneycontrol's 10.00 is suspiciously equal to the face value of the share, which suggests a field-mapping bug rather than real trade data.
3,550,200 / 5,010,000 = 70.8623% -> 70.86%. Screener rounds the wrong way. Moneycontrol agrees with the filing at 70.86%. Tiny, but it is the primary filing that screener disagrees with.

source_conflicts.field: annual revenue vs sum of quarters (single source, self-contradictory)

b.source: screener.in quarterly table, sum of FY26 quarters

source_conflicts.note: Same page, same source, 4.9x apart. FY25 mismatches too (5.84 annual vs 7.74 quarterly). FY24 reconciles exactly (7.01 vs 7.01), which rules out a definitional convention and points to a data defect in the recent years. Net profit reconciles in all three years, so only the revenue line is affected.

source_conflicts.field: BSE's own two quote endpoints disagree
source_conflicts.note: Two endpoints on the same host, same scrip, same minute. A client that happens to call the older one concludes the company has no fundamentals at all; one that calls the newer gets numbers that contradict screener. Both were fetched during this collection.

traps.name: Stale price presented as live
traps.detail: Last trade 2025-03-12, 556 days before collection. BSE, Moneycontrol and screener all render 49.88 as the headline price with only a small date stamp to betray it. Every derived figure - market cap 24.99 crore, P/E 24.5, P/B 0.69/0.75, free-float cap 7.28 crore - inherits that staleness silently. A terminal that shows 'DAL 49.88' with a green +4.99% is quoting March 2025 as today. The +4.99% change is itself 18 months old.

traps.name: Degenerate 52-week range (high == low)
traps.detail: 52w high and 52w low are both 49.88 dated 12/03/2025, so range = 0. Any %-of-52w-range, volatility, or position-in-range computation divides by zero or returns a meaningless 0/100. Month and week high/low are identically 49.88 / 49.88.

traps.name: Bare ticker 'DAL' resolves to Delta Air Lines everywhere outside BSE
traps.detail: SEC EDGAR maps DAL to {'cik_str': 27904, 'ticker': 'DAL', 'title': 'DELTA AIR LINES, INC.'}. Both sides of this collision sit inside the product's own masters (us_instruments.json DAL = Delta, bse_instruments.json 539681 = DAL). Worse, Indian aggregators do NOT resolve bare 'DAL' to this company either: Tickertape returns 16 hits for 'DAL' whose top two are marked match='EXACT' and are DALBHARAT (Dalmia Bharat) and DALMIASUG - substring matches on a different company - with Dynamic Archistructures absent entirely. Moneycontrol ranks it 11th of 12 behind Dalmia Bharat, Just Dial and Poona Dal & Oil.

traps.name: The name lies about the business, and a major aggregator believed it
traps.detail: 'Archistructures' reads as architecture/construction; the company is a non-deposit-taking NBFC that invests in mutual funds and securities. Moneycontrol classified it as 'Construction & Contracting - Civil' and hard-coded that into its URL path, while printing 'is a NBFC' in the body of the same page. Any pipeline that trusts Moneycontrol's sector will peer-compare this NBFC against civil contractors.

traps.name: Revenue does not reconcile between the annual and quarterly tables of the same source
traps.detail: screener FY26: annual revenue 1.56 INR crore vs quarters summing to 7.71. FY25: 5.84 vs 7.74. FY24: 7.01 vs 7.01 (reconciles). Net profit reconciles in all years. Any YoY growth number therefore depends on which table you read: -73.3% or -0.4%.

traps.name: Lakh/crore scale mixing inside one API response and one page
traps.detail: BSE StockTrading returns Turnover '5.99' with Turnoverin '(Lakh)' and TTQ '0.12' with TTQin '(Lakh)' alongside MktCapFull '24.99' in CRORE - three magnitudes in one JSON object, each governed by a separate sibling field. screener's P&L is in 'Rs. Crores' while its Insights block for the same company is in 'INR Lakhs'. Reading the number without its unit sibling is off by 100x.

traps.name: 90.6% of the free float is in physical form
traps.detail: Reg-31: only 136,900 of the public's 1,459,800 shares are dematerialised. 1,322,900 public shares cannot be sold on screen at all. This is the mechanical cause of the 18-month price gap, and no aggregator surfaces it - they show 29.14% 'public' as if it were tradeable float, and BSE computes a 7.28 crore 'free float market cap' on that basis.

traps.name: Empty consolidated page returns HTTP 200, not 404
traps.detail: screener.in/company/539681/consolidated/ returns 200 and renders full page chrome with every single ratio blank. A fetcher that defaults to the consolidated view records nulls for a company that simply has no consolidated statements, and cannot distinguish that from a fetch failure.

traps.name: Three legal-name spellings across two authoritative records
traps.detail: BSE's own ListofScripData returns Scrip_Name 'Dynamic Archistructures Ltd' and Issuer_Name 'dynamic Archistructures Limited' (lower-case d) in the SAME row; the company's filing says 'DYNAMIC ARCHISTRUCTURES LIMITED'. Exact-string name matching against any one of them fails against the other two.

traps.name: Group X is not SME - an easy mis-tagging
traps.detail: The scrip is BSE group X (illiquid segment) with T+1 settlement, and the company's own filing answers 'Whether company is SME: No'. Several battery peers ARE SME (group M/MT). A pipeline that treats 'obscure BSE nano-cap' as SME will apply SME lot sizes and SME disclosure rules that do not apply here.

traps.name: Fundamentals move while the price cannot
traps.detail: Q1 FY27 (Jun-2026) posted revenue 7.26 crore and net profit 5.99 crore - the largest quarter on record and roughly 24% of the entire market cap in one quarter's profit - on a stock whose last trade predates it by 15 months. Any 'price reaction to results' or momentum/坐 signal is undefined. TTM EPS swung from -7.52 (Mar-2026) to +11.96 (Jun-2026) quarter over quarter.

traps.name: P/E of 24.5 is agreed by both sources and still meaningless
traps.detail: Cross-source agreement is not validation: both compute a stale March-2025 price over a TTM EPS dominated by one outlier quarter. Meanwhile BSE's older endpoint reports no P/E at all for the same scrip. Agreement between two derived numbers that share a broken input looks like corroboration to a differ.

world_gaps.kind: genuinely does not exist in reachable sources
world_gaps.detail: The company's own Reg-31 filing leaves its 'Date of allotment / extinguishment ... / Listing Date' field BLANK. BSE's ListofScripData row carries no listing-date column, and the BSE endpoints that would (CompanyProfile, getQtrlist, ShpPromoterNGroup) all return HTTP 302 to an error page without a session. Not guessed.
No rename evidence found, but no source affirmatively states 'never renamed'. Recorded as absent-evidence rather than a confirmed null.
BSE ComHeaderNew returns OPM='-' and NPM='-' for this scrip, so only screener's -1.45% exists. Single-sourced, not cross-checked.

Tickertape has NO entry for this company: a search for 'Dynamic Archistructures' returns total=3, all marked match='SIMILAR', being Dynemic Products, Bharat Dynamics and Dynamatic Technologies. A fuzzy-matching fallback would silently substitute a 5,769 crore defence PSU for a 25 crore NBFC. Moneycontrol carries it but only surfaces it for a 'DAL' query, not for its own full name.

Pledge is confirmed nil for Jun-2026 from the primary filing. Prior quarters would each need a separate fetch from the company's own site; BSE's shareholding API is not reachable unauthenticated (302).
